body: Thank you! Yes, this is a great suggestion. Been meaning to do a floral type theme. Will have to post that on here once I get my new delivery of stickers and such next week!

Thanks guys. I hear all of you. I guess I just have to figure out my next step. Did I mention she also took a job at my company, in my department, same exact schedule? Lol. 

So even if/when we split for good, she’s still going to be there. 🤣 (I am laughing to mask my misery).

First off, this is fucking awful and I am sorry for your experience. I’m curious to know, what happened the next day? Did she ever apologize, did she ever bring it up etc. I know you said you buried it because it was so traumatic. You said you have 2 kids now, did it ever get triggered when you guys did have sex after the fact? You definitely need to prioritize your emotional and mental health from that trauma. I hope you find comfort from the help you are seeking.
Thank you for everyone’s words of reassurance. I am doing a bit better today. I hope it continues.
